description.zh: 幂等 Token。用于保证重复请求不会重复执行同一操作。
description.en: The idempotency token. Ensures that repeated requests do not execute the same operation more than once.

description.zh: 是否直接完成恢复。不传时默认值为 false。
description.en: Specifies whether to complete the restoration immediately. Default value: false.

description.zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to query or perform the operation.

description.zh: 恢复后的分支名称。不传时由后端生成。
description.en: The name of the restored branch. If not specified, the backend generates a name automatically.
The snapshot LSN used for restoration.

description.zh: 目标分支 ID。不传时由后端按恢复流程选择目标分支。
description.en: The target branch ID. If not specified, the backend selects the target branch based on the restoration process.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于基于快照 LSN 恢复到目标分支。可以指定恢复分支名称和目标分支，FinalizeRestore 用于控制是否直接完成恢复。
descriptions.en: Restores to a target branch based on a snapshot LSN. You can specify the restored branch name and the target branch. FinalizeRestore controls whether to complete the restoration immediately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb restore-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --restored-lsn 0/3522648 --target-branch-id br-main --restored-branch-name restore_preview --finalize-restore false --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb RestoreSnapshot --region cn-hangzhou --TargetBranchId 'br-main' --RestoredBranchName restore_preview --FinalizeRestore false --ProjectId 'spb-xxxx' --RestoredLsn '0/3522648' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
